$comment: Probes that fail TODAY, where, and the pull request that fixes each (verdict.mjs). The list may only shrink: a listed probe that passes turns its cell red, so the fixing pull request deletes its entry. `when` maps an axis to a value or a list; an entry without `when` matches every run. Entries were derived from local runs on Vitest 5 (all RNTL versions, both engines, every runtime combination) except where `why` says otherwise.

entries.why: RNTL registers cleanup only through a global afterEach. Both engines, every RNTL.
RNTL drives fake timers only through a global jest, which only jest-compat defines. Both engines, every RNTL, globals on or off.
RCTVirtualText is registered as a text host for RNTL 14 only.
react-test-renderer 19 reports a recoverable error through process.emit('uncaughtException'). RNTL 14 renders without it. Both engines.
A synchronous requireActual compiles a second module graph under Node. Both engines.
The sibling's directory is externalized, so Node loads the aliased source and its own store. Observed to pass with jest-compat on, whose Node-side resolution reaches the same copy.
Node's alias fallback cannot represent a regex alias: Cannot find module.
Node compiles the aliased source to CommonJS: Cannot use 'import.meta' outside a module.
Babel's interopRequireDefault reads exports.default from __esModule CommonJS.
jest.useFakeTimers passes Jest's options to Vitest, which drops advanceTimers. Both engines.
Vitest compares Errors' own enumerable properties, per-instance methods included. Both engines.
The banner names no presets. Both engines.

NOT observed locally (no Vitest 4 on this machine): from #338, which reproduced it on Vitest 4.1.11. Vitest 4.1 replays a remembered factory from a placeholder node the hot runtime keeps across files; Vitest 5 is unaffected.
